title: Instagram gets a new wordmark for the first time in over 10 years
description: Meta has introduced a refreshed wordmark for Instagram, featuring a new font and styling while retaining elements of the original design. The updated wordmark is now visible at the top of Instagram's mobile apps. Instagram head Adam Mosseri announced the new wordmark in posts on Instagram and Threads, noting that the previous design had remained unchanged for 10 years and was due for a refresh. Apple Intelligence custom model is launching soon in China
description: Last year, reports confirmed that Apple had picked Alibaba to power its Apple Intelligence features in China. A new report from Reuters News suggests that Apple has finalized training its China-specific LLM, which will be powered by Alibaba’s Qwen AI. This development is noteworthy as Apple would be the first foreign company to get approval from Chinese regulators to offer a proprietary AI model in China. title: Motorola Moto G Max comes to India with a different set of specs
description: Motorola today launched the Moto G Max in India, and it's different from the one introduced in June in Brazil. For starters, the Brazilian Moto G Max, which is a rebranded Moto G87, is powered by the Dimensity 6400 SoC, while the Indian Moto G Max has the Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chip at the helm. The memory options are different, too: the Brazilian model comes with up to 12GB RAM and 512GB storage, but the Indian model comes in a single 6GB/128GB configuration. Both models run Android 16 out of the box, with the Indian version confirmed to get two Android OS upgrades and three years of...

title: Google's Tensor G6 inside the Pixel 11 series isn't a 2nm chip
description: Google unveiled the Pixel 11 series smartphones a couple of days ago, with the Tensor G6 inside. While Google didn't explicitly mention it anywhere, the Tensor G6 was widely believed to be a 2nm chip. Turns out that's not the case. [#InlinePriceWidget,14874,1#] This revelation comes from Google's VP of Hardware, Peng Yu-Chun, who confirmed that the Tensor G6 inside all the Pixel 11 series smartphones is based on TSMC's 3nm process. Last year's Tensor G5 is also a 3nm chip. [#InlinePriceWidget,14800,1#] Even if the Tensor G6 was based on a 2nm process, it wouldn't have been the...

title: iPhone Ultra now said to be confined to one market at launch
description: A new report from Australia of all places today claims that while Apple will unveil the foldable iPhone Ultra at its September 8 event, the device will not be released at the same time as the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, which are also expected to be announced on the same occasion. Not just that, but apparently the iPhone Ultra will only be released in the US first, followed by a handful of other key markets, including China. Australia, for what it's worth, won't be one of them. Interestingly, this report also claims that Apple will not announce pricing for the iPhone Ultra...

title: iQOO Neo11 Ultra, Z11s chipset details revealed ahead of launch
description: Ahead of their August 18 launch in China, iQOO has revealed the chipsets powering the Neo11 Ultra and Z11s. The company had previously shared the design and battery specifications of both smartphones. The iQOO Neo11 Ultra will be powered by a custom Dimensity 9500M chipset, which features an all-big-core CPU architecture. Built on a 3nm process, iQOO says that the chipset was developed specifically for the upcoming smartphone. iQOO claims the custom chipset will deliver “top-tier performance and power efficiency” thanks to the Monster Hyper-Core engine. title: iPhone X joins Apple's obsolete product list
description: Apple's 10th anniversary iPhone, the iPhone X, has finally been added to the company's obsolete products list, nearly nine years after its launch. The company has also added the 2018 15-inch MacBook Pro to the list. Once a product is added to Apple's obsolete products list, it is no longer eligible for hardware service, and repair centers will no longer be able to obtain replacement parts. Products are usually added to the obsolete list more than 7 years after Apple stops its sale. However, Mac products may still be eligible for battery service for up to 10 years from the date they...

title: Google already launches Gemini 3.7 Flash
description: Just three weeks after launching Gemini 3.6 Flash, today Google is releasing Gemini 3.7 Flash. The company says this is its "most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents". Gemini 3.7 Flash is "the direct result of developer feedback and algorithmic innovations" that will also be used in future models, according to Google. Compared to Gemini 3.6 Flash, Gemini 3.7 Flash has improvements in software engineering, knowledge work, and web development workflows. Google says Gemini 3.7 Flash will be better than its predecessor at coding tasks like debugging and issue...

title: Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra mega leak brings images, specs, and prices
description: A few hours ago a leak talked about the battery capacities of the upcoming Poco F9 Pro and Poco F9 Ultra, and now we have a mega leak with renders and specs for both devices. As expected, the Poco F9 Pro is a rebranded Redmi K100 Pro with a smaller battery, and the Poco F9 Ultra is a rebranded Redmi K100 Pro Max with a smaller battery. Otherwise, the specs are identical to their Chinese counterparts. The F9 Pro has a 6,330 mAh battery and the F9 Ultra has an 8,050 mAh battery (compared to 8,580 mAh and 9,070 mAh on the Redmi K100 Pro and Pro Max, respectively). Poco F9 Pro...

title: Here's when the Fairphone 6+ is rumored to launch and how much it will cost
description: According to a new rumor, the Fairphone 6+ will become official on August 18. It will be priced at around €685, based on a listing in Denmark. Of course, the price may slightly vary in other European markets because of different VAT rates. In fact, it may not be that bad in the Eurozone - a leak from France said the RRP would be €649. That's €50 more than the Fairphone 6's launch price, and €100 more than it costs today. title: Galaxy Z Fold8 does not impress in teardown
description: Earlier this week we saw the Galaxy Z Fold8 go through JerryRigEverything’s torture durability test where it survived some hard bends and close encounters with blades and sand. And the team over at iFixit has now brought its teardown expertise to Samsung’s trendy bendy phone. Here’s the full video: The Z Fold8 earned a 4/10 repairability score. That’s not impressive by regular smartphone standards, but it is a point higher than last year’s Z Fold7 repairability score. title: Counterpoint: US smartphone market contracts, budget devices hit hardest
description: Counterpoint Research’s latest report examines smartphone sales in the US for the April 1 – June 30 period, aka Q2. The overall market fell by 5% compared to last year as the ongoing memory chip crisis resulted in increased average asking prices (ASP) for devices across the board. In addition, rising gas prices due to the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East also affected consumer purchasing power. Apple, Samsung, Motorola and Google saw their combined sales drop by 4% on a year-over-year basis. The remaining brands doing business in the US saw their sales decline by up to 45% compared to...

title: Apple again reported to skip launching the iPhone 18 this year
description: Apple has long been rumored to launch the iPhone 18 series and the iPhone Ultra in phases, with multiple reports claiming the iPhone 18 won't launch this year. Now, a new media report, citing Apple supplier Pegatron, again states that the iPhone 18 won't launch this year and will arrive in 2027 instead. During the earnings call for Q2 2026, Pegatron confirmed that the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max will be launched next month, but the iPhone 18 is expected to launch in Q1 2027, meaning anytime between January and March 2027. title: Google promises 7 years of spare parts availability for the Pixel 11 lineup
description: Google officially unveiled the Pixel 11 series at its Made by Google event. Google has now shared details about the availability of spare parts for the new smartphones. At the Pixel 11 series launch event in India, Google reportedly confirmed that it will provide 7 years of spare parts support for the new smartphones. Google says spares will be available in every market where the Pixel 11 series is sold, making it easier for users to replace components such as the battery or display even years after buying the phone. description: There have been conflicting reports surrounding Apple’s twentieth-anniversary iPhone, aka the iPhone 20 Pro, lately. Earlier this week, the all-glass device was said to be canceled due to alleged low yield rates but a second report from Bloomberg quickly refuted those claims and said that the device is still on track to launch next year. Tipster Digital Chat Station is now chiming in with details surrounding the iPhone 20 Pro and 20 Pro Max. title: Xiaomi unveils HyperOS 4 with a new glass look, UI customizations and more AI
description: Xiaomi’s HyperOS releases aren’t tied to Android releases – the company is rolling out the Android 17 update as HyperOS 3 and now it has unveiled HyperOS 4, which will most likely be based on the same core. It features a heavily reworked user interface, though. Do you like the new glass UI trend? Well, too bad – it’s the new design language for HyperOS 4. The system will even put effort into rendering realistic-looking refraction. title: Tecno Pova 8 Pro unveiled with an Alive Matrix Display, P1 Graphic Chip, and 144FPS gaming support
description: The Tecno Pova 8 Pro that we've been hearing about for the past few months is now official. The Tecno Pova 8 Pro is powered by the Dimensity 7400 Ultimate SoC and comes with up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage onboard. The smartphone also has a P1 Graphic Chip under the hood to enhance the gaming experience and enable 144FPS gaming through game frame interpolation. Tecno says the Pova 8 Pro supports 90FPS gameplay in RPG games and 144FPS gameplay in FPS and MOBA games. title: Apple wants to pay publishers to use their content in Siri AI
description: According to a new report, Apple wants to make content deals with online publishers, possibly worth up to nine figures, for the new Siri AI to be able to use their stuff so it can answer questions about current events and information. Apple has allegedly proposed a variable compensation plan. Payments would only be made to the publishers it partners with if their content is used in Siri AI. Apple wants to be proactive here and play the good guy so that it can avoid being sued by publishers for using their content for AI services. This isn't just a theoretical possibility, either....

description: During the unveiling of the Robot Phone, Honor also teased the upcoming Magic9 series, which is going to be unveiled in September. The company's teaser image revealed that one of the devices will have a 200MP camera using a 1/1.4" type sensor with OIS. This is the same size as the Magic8 Pro's periscope telephoto camera.
